target.role: fresh whole-journey belonging and placement discovery for STRANGE GAIT
target.position: Whole journey: before the opener, between every non-protected pair, or after the tail. Preserve only Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer; Truth in Noise → Transparency remains available.
target.purpose: Test a current bass-techno title track, one current emerging-label compilation cut, two adjacent syncopated or broken forms, and one overlooked machine-funk construction. Character change is allowed; admission still requires purposeful transition, local-run and long-form effect.

sourceWindows: CURRENT 2026 / NERVE COLLECT: https://teqmun.bandcamp.com/album/a-man-and-his-toad — all five tracks were screened. Teqmun — A Man and His Toad was retained from the official exact-track description of syncopated bass, restrained swagger, fizzing synths and skeletal patterns that surface and recede.

CURRENT 2026 / EMERGING MYRYRS: https://myryrs.bandcamp.com/album/myryrs3 — all eight compilation tracks were screened. Sunil Sharpe — Rushneck Break was retained from the official exact-track description of an off-kilter switchboard running into overdrive; the digital track title is singular even though the prose uses the plural.

ADJACENT / IN ARMATURA: https://inarmatura.bandcamp.com/album/10-11 — the four individual tracks and two companion mixes were screened. Tano — Blend of Poetry was retained from the official exact-track description of off-kilter basslines and rapid-fire percussion.

ADJACENT / BLACK MAGIC: https://blackmagicrecs.bandcamp.com/album/flunk — Actual — Flunk was retained from the official exact-track description of a baile-funk, broken-beat and UK-techno mutation built on syncopated, swaying drums.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / DUST SCIENCE: https://theblackdog.bandcamp.com/album/telepathica-ep-fred-giannelli — all three tracks were screened. Fred Giannelli — Distant Gratification was retained from the official exact-track description of two machines meshing, off-kilter kicks and insistent syncopated synths and beats.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: MYRYRS3 alternate tracks including Egregore — Delusion -> Discernment, IZC's The Navigators EP, CAIV's Lives EP, Actual and Black Magic label-adjacent releases, and 2026 Resident Advisor/Bandcamp release windows were screened. Their weaker exact-track evidence or overlap with recently explored lanes did not outrank the five leads.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 39 named tracks across current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Exact identities and primary discovery lanes retained in Runs 53–69 were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.

No lead was promoted for recency, reputation, genre, novelty, title or technical cleverness. Fred Giannelli's Bandcamp page misspells his surname with one n in the first track listing but uses the two-n spelling in the release title, credits and production credit; the resolver must establish the Spotify identity without substitution.
Energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, perceived pulse, phrase structure, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Teqmun — A Man and His Toad: strongest current exact-track case, with syncopated bass and skeletal patterns that surface and recede.
2. Fred Giannelli — Distant Gratification: strongest overlooked catalogue case, built from off-kilter kicks and insistent syncopated machine interplay.
3. Sunil Sharpe — Rushneck Break: current emerging-label cut with exact off-kilter and overdrive evidence.
4. Tano — Blend of Poetry: adjacent bass-techno lead with exact off-kilter bassline and rapid-fire percussion evidence.
5. Actual — Flunk: adjacent hybrid lead with exact syncopated-drum evidence across baile funk, broken beat and UK techno.
